feed.title: Petfood Watch
feed.subtitle: Daily AI-assisted intelligence on the pet food industry: market, M&A, regulation and innovation news from trade press, with per-article summaries and a daily briefing.

entry.title: HenArt launches Levendo dog food with Enifer mycoprotein
entry.summary: HenArt introduces Levendo dog food featuring Enifer mycoprotein, offering a baked, complete meal for adult and senior dogs. This marks Enifer’s first international consumer launch of its Pekilo fermented product.
